sourceOrder.when: neighbor block is the current wall instance OR neighbor block instanceof FenceGateBlock

oldPredicate.materialIsSolidBlocking: Material.isSolidBlocking() is exactly !translucent && blocksMovement(). AirMaterial and PlantMaterial override blocksMovement() to false; LiquidMaterial and PortalMaterial do likewise; COBWEB's anonymous material also returns false. LEAVES, GLASS, TNT, ICE, SNOW_LAYER, and CACTUS are translucent. Therefore a Material name allowlist or modern render solidity predicate is not a source-equivalent reduction by itself.

variantOwner.meaning: instance-family property, not a state property; registered single slab false, registered double slab true

isCube.stateDispatch: StateDefinition's concrete BlockState.isCube delegates to owning Block.isCube(state). No geometric collision-shape test is part of the old predicate.

oldPredicate.derivedClassifier: Old generic true = (legacy identity is not barrier, wall-self, or fence-gate) AND old material's !translucent && blocksMovement AND old class/instance isCube AND old material is not PUMPKIN; wall-self and fence-gate short-circuits are true.

newNativePredicate.formula: WallBlock.connectsTo: state is in BlockTags.WALLS OR (!Block.isExceptionForConnection(state) AND direction-specific state.isFaceSturdy(level,pos,side)) OR IronBarsBlock OR (FenceGateBlock and connectsToDirection(state, direction)).
newNativePredicate.wallNeighborQuery: isFaceSturdy uses native SupportType.FULL when called with three arguments; the direction is the side facing the wall.
newNativePredicate.nonEquivalence: 26.2 face support is direction-sensitive, and native WallBlock adds wall-tag and iron-bars cases. The old generic predicate is direction-independent and does not include those cases. Neither modern isSolidRender nor isCollisionShapeFullBlock proves old isCube/material flags.

closedMappings.proof: Both source registries expose barrier; old predicate hard-rejects identity before gate/solid checks; 26.2 exception list also includes barrier.
Both source registries expose pumpkin; old predicate excludes Material.PUMPKIN after solid/cube checks; 26.2 exception list includes pumpkin.

Old ID 101 constructs PaneBlock with Material.IRON. PaneBlock overrides old isCube=false, so the old generic result is false. 26.2 BlockItemIds.IRON_BARS resolves the iron_bars identity; Blocks registers IronBarsBlock there, and modern WallBlock connects to IronBarsBlock unconditionally. This is a source-proven old/native classifier divergence for the same resource identity.

Old registration ID 103 constructs MelonBlock(Material.PUMPKIN); old isCube defaults true, then the old pumpkin-material exclusion yields false. 26.2 Blocks registers generic Block at BlockItemIds.MELON (resource melon), and Block.isExceptionForConnection includes Blocks.MELON, yielding false for this renamed identity. This closes this renamed false/false pair only.

registeredBlockInventory.extraction: All 236 numeric registration calls in old Block.java are recorded (IDs 0-234 and 255) with numeric ID, resource name, constructed runtime class, old isCube result, material as needed, and effective old wall-neighbor result including special identity/class cases. Old superclass isCube overrides and eight slab registration instance classes are resolved. 136 exact same-name 26.2 resources are passed through Blocks registration helpers; 100 old names are unmatched or renamed. Twenty-six old effective material values remain unspecified, all on rows with old isCube=false; cobblestone_wall (ID 139) resolves to STONE through the shared constructor and its true effective result short-circuits through wall identity.

mappingGates: The extraction covers all 236 numeric registrations in old Block.java (IDs 0-234 and 255); 136 exact same-name 26.2 resource identities are passed to a Blocks.java registration helper. The other 100 names require explicit renamed/merged counterpart evidence or remain open. Same spelling does not prove state-property conversion.

The old result is resolved for all registrations from old Material.isSolidBlocking, block-class isCube overrides, and the registration-instance rule for eight slab classes. Twenty-six old effective Material values remain unspecified, all 26 have old isCube=false and resolve false. Cobblestone wall resolves to STONE from its shared Material.STONE constructor; its effective result is true via the preceding same-wall identity branch. This row is closed by explicit source evidence.

Legacy metadata affects selected block states but does not vary old isCube except slabs; eight slab registrations have separate single/double runtime classes, and their old isCube isDouble result is encoded per registration. Target 26.2 state/property equivalence is not exhaustively proven.
Modern-only 26.2 identities and unmatched/renamed identities without explicit source linkage remain open; no old result is extrapolated to modern-only states.

No universal 26.2 native predicate equals the old classifier. Modern isFaceSturdy(FULL) is directional and native wall logic adds wall-tag, iron-bars, and directional fence-gate cases. Do not substitute isSolidRender, collision-full-block, or face-sturdy for the old material/isCube contract.
conclusion: Exact old results are resolved for all 236 old registered IDs from source. Exact same-name identity/helper references exist for 136; 100 names remain renamed/unmatched until explicit evidence closes them. This proves no universal 26.2 native equivalent: modern wall logic adds directional face support and wall/iron-bars/fence-gate rules. Result is bounded to old registrations and explicitly evidenced mappings; modern-only 26.2 identities remain open.
